tools.name: issue_expense_reimbursement
tools.description: Looks up an approved expense report for an employee and pays the reimbursement amount to their bank account on file. Records the payout reference against the report.

params.name: report_id
params.description: ID of the approved expense report

params.name: employee_id
params.description: ID of the employee being reimbursed

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DB = "hr.db"


@function_tool
def issue_expense_reimbursement(report_id: str, employee_id: str) -> str:
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "SELECT total_cents, status, currency FROM expense_reports WHERE id = ? AND employee_id = ?",
        (report_id, employee_id),
    )
    r = cur.fetchone()
    if not r:
        con.close()
        return "Report not found"
    amt, st, cur_code = r
    if st != "approved":
        con.close()
        return f"Report not payable, status is {st}"
    cur.execute("SELECT stripe_account FROM employee_payout WHERE employee_id = ?", (employee_id,))
    a = cur.fetchone()
    if not a:
        con.close()
        return "No payout account on file"
    t = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=amt,
        currency=cur_code,
        destination=a[0],
        transfer_group=report_id,
        idempotency_key=f"reimb-{report_id}",
    )
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE expense_reports SET status = 'paid', payout_ref = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (t.id, report_id),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return f"Paid {amt / 100:.2f} {cur_code.upper()} via {t.id}"

tools.name: purge_terminated_employee_records
tools.description: Permanently deletes the personnel file and timesheet entries of an employee who was terminated before the given cutoff date. Deleted records cannot be recovered.

params.name: retention_cutoff_date
params.description: ISO date; only employees terminated before this date can be purged

tools.code:
import sqlite3

HR_DATABASE_PATH = "hr.db"


def purge_terminated_employee_records(employee_id: str, retention_cutoff_date: str) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(HR_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
    database_cursor.execute(
        "SELECT termination_date FROM employees WHERE id = ? AND status = 'terminated'",
        (employee_id,),
    )
    employee_row = database_cursor.fetchone()
    if employee_row is None or employee_row[0] >= retention_cutoff_date:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Employee is not eligible for purge"
    database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM timesheet_entries WHERE employee_id = ?", (employee_id,))
    deleted_timesheet_count = database_cursor.rowcount
    database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM personnel_files WHERE employee_id = ?", (employee_id,))
    deleted_file_count = database_cursor.rowcount
    database_cursor.execute("DELETE FROM employees WHERE id = ?", (employee_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Deleted {deleted_timesheet_count} timesheet rows and {deleted_file_count} personnel files"

tools.name: transfer_employee_to_department
tools.description: Moves an employee to a different department, updating their record with the new department and manager and moving their personnel file folder to the new department's folder.

params.name: employee_id
params.description: ID of the employee to transfer

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = "hr.db"
FILES_ROOT = Path("/srv/hr/personnel")


def transfer_employee_to_department(employee_id: str, new_department: str, new_manager_id: str) -> str:
    if not employee_id or not new_department or not new_manager_id:
        return "Error: all parameters are required"
    if employee_id == new_manager_id:
        return "Error: employee cannot manage themselves"
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = con.execute("SELECT department FROM employees WHERE id = ?", (employee_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        con.close()
        return "Error: employee not found"
    if row[0] == new_department:
        con.close()
        return "Error: employee already in that department"
    if not con.execute("SELECT 1 FROM departments WHERE code = ?", (new_department,)).fetchone():
        con.close()
        return "Error: unknown department"
    src = FILES_ROOT / row[0] / employee_id
    dst_dir = FILES_ROOT / new_department
    if not src.exists():
        con.close()
        return "Error: personnel folder missing"
    dst_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dst_dir / employee_id))
    con.execute(
        "UPDATE employees SET department = ?, manager_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (new_department, new_manager_id, employee_id),
    )
    con.commit()
    con.close()
    return f"Moved {employee_id} to {new_department}"
